verdict.rationale: ClickUp explicitly lists 'Docs' as a core product alongside Whiteboards, Sprints, Automations, etc., confirming it exists as a workspace feature for notes/docs tied to project work, but there is no detail on sharing, permissions, or organizational structure within Docs. Missing for 10: evidence of doc organization/nesting features, sharing/collaboration mechanics, and any independent hands-on confirmation of the Docs experience.
